messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPENED: reports from Sentry show a gap in exception events starting ~12:12 UTC. Auto-page: @Sam (oncall).

Sam (oncall): seeing a drop in exception counts in the Sentry dashboard, but app metrics look normal — CPU and requests steady. Notified by alert: "sentry.events.ingest.rate_drop".

Leah (sre): on it. Do we have any recent deploys?

Sam (oncall): nope, no deploys in last 2 hours. Rolling back nothing.

Jorge (platform): I'm seeing 5xx spikes from our Sentry proxy at 12:11-12:18 in the logs: lots of `GET /api/0/store/` returning 429 and occasional 401. Looks like our auth provider (AuthX) started rate-limiting token introspection calls.

Sam (oncall): can you paste the log snippet?

Jorge (platform): ```
2026-03-15T12:11:22Z proxy-1 ERROR upstream response 429 from authx.introspect token_id=abc123
2026-03-15T12:12:05Z proxy-1 WARN store request dropped due to auth failure 401 token_id=def456
2026-03-15T12:13:01Z proxy-2 ERROR upstream response 429 authx quota exceeded
```

Leah (sre): that matches missing events — Sentry SDKs can't authenticate when our proxy can't validate tokens. This is a dependency incident (AuthX).

Tara (customer-success): any customer impact so far? Are we dropping crash reports to customers?

Sam (oncall): tentative impact: error grouping & triage delayed for users relying on Sentry. No PagerDuty for app-level pages yet. I'll run a quick sample to see if events are queued client-side.

Sam (oncall): commands I'm running: `kubectl -n sentry logs -l app=sentry-proxy --since=30m | grep "authx"`

ops-bot: Deploy job note: canary rollback not required. Monitoring threshold not breached for traffic.

Jorge (platform): mitigation options: 1) temporarily bypass token introspection for internal SDKs (config toggle), 2) fallback to a cached service token we control, 3) throttle SDK ingestion locally and return 202 queued to reduce pressure.

Leah (sre): quick safe move is #2 — swap to cached service token (short-lived) so proxy can accept events without introspection. I'll prepare the secret rotation steps.

Sam (oncall): do it. Add a banner in Sentry UI (if possible) warning of degraded exception coverage.

Jorge (platform): prepping a small config change: `sentry-proxy.env -> AUTH_INTROSPECTION_MODE=cache_fallback` — will push to staging first then to all proxies. Applying now.

Leah (sre): rolling to prod proxies. Watch for authentication 401s to drop and event counts to recover.

Sam (oncall): confirmed initial success — 401s decreasing. Events ingested rate recovering to ~70% of baseline. Marking partial mitigation.

Tara (customer-success): I'll draft a short customer note: "We're experiencing degraded error-reporting due to our auth provider. We're mitigating and will backfill missing data where possible."

Sam (oncall): important: vendor (AuthX) status page shows rate-limiting incident in their compute region. I'm opening a support ticket and attaching proxy logs.

Jorge (platform): opened ticket #AX-4721 with AuthX, included request IDs. They replied: "We're throttling introspection by client due to upstream load; ETA 45-90m."

Leah (sre): plan for next 90 minutes: 1) keep cache_fallback in place, 2) start ingestion backfill for the 12:10-12:25 window if we can reconstruct events from our edge buffer/storage, 3) monitor for duplicates.

Sam (oncall): can you outline backfill steps? I can run them.

Jorge (platform): backfill script: `python tools/sentry_backfill.py --source s3://edge-uploads/2026-03-15/12 --target sentry --start 12:10 --end 12:25 --dry-run` — run dry-run first to see counts, then actual. Note: we need to de-dupe using event_id.

Leah (sre): run dry-run now. If counts look sane, run actual and monitor ingestion rate to avoid overloading.

Sam (oncall): dry-run shows ~8.8k candidate events. Looks good. Running actual backfill.

ops-bot: Backfill job started: job-id=backfill-18311-1. ETA ~12m.

Sam (oncall): backfill completed — 8,031 events inserted, de-duped ~780. Sentry event counts now at ~96% baseline. Good.

Tara (customer-success): telling impacted customers the timeline: event drop ~12:10-12:25 UTC, mitigation and backfill completed by 12:52 UTC.

Leah (sre): next steps: 1) monitor AuthX reply and revert cache_fallback once stable, 2) run postmortem template, 3) add detection for introspection 429s to page earlier.

Jorge (platform): added temporary alert: `sentry.proxy.authx.429.rate > 5/min` to incidents channel. Will make it permanent after postmortem.

Sam (oncall): handoff — I'm done for shift. Leaving notes in the incident doc with actions outstanding: contact AuthX for RCA, automate fallback toggle in runbook, verify duplicate suppression logic. Handoff to Leah for follow-up.

Leah (sre): taking over. I'll own the postmortem and vendor follow-up.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: partial service degradation resolved and backfilled. Duration: 42m. Severity: Sev-2.

Sam (oncall): thanks team. Adding `#postmortem` link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1831122334/postmortem

Tara (customer-success): leaving a note in CS tracker with customers potentially affected: enterprise accounts A, C flagged for outreach.

Leah (sre): assigned: Leah (owner), Jorge (platform), Sam (oncall), Tara (CS). ETA for postmortem: EOD tomorrow.

Jorge (platform): final note — AuthX later confirmed a misconfigured autoscaler caused token introspection overload. They committed to patch and throttling limits change. We'll follow up on SLA adjustments.

Sam (oncall): reaction :thumbsup: Great work everyone."
